5108 }
5109 else
5110 {
5111 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE()
5112 }
5113 }
5114 else

5116 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
5117 }
5118 // P40A0012 end
5119 }
5120 }
5121 catch( FrameworkErrorSignal &fes )

11079 throw fwes ;

15894// Class: PosProcessOperationSpecification
15895//
15896// Service: void setProcessDefinitions(in PosProcessDefinitionSequence pdseq)
15897//
15898// Change history:
15899// Date Defect# Person Comments
15900// -------- -------- -------------- -------------------------------------------
15901// 03/19/02 D4100020 F.Masada Initial release.
15902// 06/17/03 P5000018 F.Masada Add nil check
15903// 02/17/04 P5100147 K.Kido Change DataMember clear logic for HAS.
15904// 07/14/04 D5100309 F.Masada Set thePreviousProcessDefinition before setting theProcessDefinitions.
15905//
15906// Description:
15907// set the process definitions
15908// Return:
15909// void
15910// Parameter:
15911// PosProcessDefinitionSequence
15912// Require:
15913// none
15914// Ensure:
15915// none
15916// Exception:
15917// none
15918// Pseudo code:
15919// thePreviousProcessDefinition.identifier = theProcessDefinitions.identifier; //D5100309
15920// thePreviousProcessDefinition.stringifiedObjectReference = theProcessDefinitions.stringifiedObjectReference; //D5100309
15921// theProcessDefinitions = pdseq
15922//
15923//D6000025 void PosProcessOperationSpecification_i:: setProcessDefinitions ( const PosProcessDefinitionSequence& pdseq,
15924//D6000025 CORBA::Environment &IT_env )
15925void PosProcessOperationSpecification_i:: setProcessDefinitions ( const PosProcessDefinitionSequence& pdseq //D6000025
15926 CORBAENV_LAST_CPP ) //D6000025
15927{
15928 SPFW_METHODTRACEENTRY( "PosProcessOperationSpecification::setProcessDefinitions" ); // RAS
15929 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
15930 try
15931 {
15932 CIMFW_SET_DIRTY() ;
15933 CORBA::Long nLen = pdseq.length() ;
15934
15935 #ifdef ENABLE_MULTIPLE_PROCESSDEFINITIONS_PER_POS
15936//P5100147 UNINIT_COLLECTIONDATAMEMBER( theProcessDefinitions ) ;
15937 theProcessDefinitions->removeAll(); //P5100147
15938 CORBA::String_var = id ;
15939 CORBA::String_var = objref ;
15940
15941 for ( CORBA::Long i = 0 ; i < nLen ; i++)
15942 {
15943 if(CORBA::is_nil(pdseq[i])) throw FrameworkErrorSignal() ; //P5000018
15944 id = pdseq[i]->getIdentifier();
15945 SET_STRINGIFIEDOBJREF( objref, pdseq[i] );
15946 theProcessDefinitions->addLast( CIMFWStrDup( id ), CIMFWStrDup( objref ) );
15947 }
15948
15949 #else
15950 UNINIT_OBJECTIDENTIFIER(thePreviousProcessDefinition); //D5100309
15951 thePreviousProcessDefinition.identifier = theProcessDefinitions.identifier; //D5100309
15952 thePreviousProcessDefinition.stringifiedObjectReference = theProcessDefinitions.stringifiedObjectReference; //D5100309
15953
15954 UNINIT_OBJECTIDENTIFIER( theProcessDefinitions );
15955 if ( nLen > 0 )
15956 {
15957 if ( !CORBA::is_nil( pdseq[0] ) )
15958 {
15959 SET_OBJECTIDENTIFIER( theProcessDefinitions, pdseq[0] );
15960 }
15961 }
15962 #endif
15963 }
15964 SPFW_CATCH_FRAMEWORK_AND_SYSTEM_EXCEPTIONS_AND_PROPAGATE_CATCH()
15965 SPFW_METHODTRACEEXIT( "PosProcessOperationSpecification::setProcessDefinitions" ); // RAS
15966}

17946 SPFW_METHODTRACEEXIT( "PosProcessOperationSpecification::setReworkProcessFlowConnections" );

18325 MSG_OBJECT_NOT_EXIST,
18326 "MessageDefinition") ;
18327
18328 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.reworkActions[nRwkActionsCnt].customField = defaultReplaceTimeRestrictionsForReworkRoute[nRwkIdx].customField;
18329 nRwkActionsCnt++;
18330 }
18331//DSN000100682 add end
18332 }
18333 }
18334 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.reworks.length(nRwkCnt);
18335 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.reworkActions.length(nRwkActionsCnt); //DSN000100682
18336//DSN000085792 add end
18337
18338 j = 0;
18339 actionCnt = 10;
18340 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions.length(actionCnt);
18341 newKeyFlag = FALSE ;
18342 }
18343
18344 if( j >= actionCnt )
18345 {
18346 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18347 actionCnt += EXPAND_ACTIONLEN;
18348 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions.length(actionCnt);
18349 }
18350
18351 if ( !CIMFWStrCmp( strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.action, SP_QTimeRestriction_Action_DispatchPrecede ) )
18352 {
18353 if ( dispatchPrecedeFoundFlag == FALSE )
18354 {
18355 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18356 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration = (CORBA::Double)(strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.duration) ;
18357 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration = (aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration) * 60 * 1000 ;
18358 dispatchPrecedeFoundFlag = TRUE;
18359 addDispatchPrecedeActionFlag = TRUE; //PSN000101301

18364 // do nothing. ignore duplicate 'DispatchPrecede'.

18366 }

18372 if ( CIMFWStrCmp( strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.action, SP_QTimeRestriction_Action_DispatchPrecede )
18373 || ( qtimeDispatchPrecedeUseCustomFieldFlag && addDispatchPrecedeActionFlag ) )
18374//PSN000101301 add end
18375 {
18376 addDispatchPrecedeActionFlag = FALSE; //PSN000101301
18377
18378 //DSN000087485 add start
18379 if( CIMFWStrCmp( getenv(SP_QTIME_IMMEDIATEHOLD_SET_FLAG), "1" ) == 0 )
18380 {
18381 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18382 if ( !CIMFWStrCmp( strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.action, SP_QTimeRestriction_Action_ImmediateHold ) )
18383 {
18384 if( dispatchPrecedeFoundFlag == FALSE )
18385 {
18386 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18387 if ( aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration == -1 )
18388 {
18389 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18390 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration = (CORBA::Double)(strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.duration) ;
18391 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration = (aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration) * 60 * 1000 ;
18392 }
18393 else
18394 {
18395 if ( aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration > ((CORBA::Double)strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.duration * 60 * 1000) )
18396 {
18397 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18398 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration = (CORBA::Double)(strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.duration) ;
18399 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration = (aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.expiredTimeDuration) * 60 * 1000 ;
18400 }
18401 else
18402 {
18403 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18404 // do nothing.
18405 }
18406 }
18407 }
18408 else
18409 {
18410 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18411 // do nothing.
18412 }
18413 }
18414 }
18415 //DSN000087485 add end
18416
18417 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions[j].expiredTimeDuration = (CORBA::Double)(strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.duration) ;
18418 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions[j].expiredTimeDuration = (aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions[j].expiredTimeDuration) * 60 * 1000 ;
18419
18420 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions[j].action = strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.action;

18433 MSG_OBJECT_NOT_EXIST,
18434 "ProcessDefinition") ;

18443 MSG_OBJECT_NOT_EXIST,
18444 "MessageDefinition") ;
18445
18446 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions[j].customField = strDefaultTimeRestrictionData.customField;
18447 j++;
18448 }
18449
18450 // Check Key

18463 dispatchPrecedeFoundFlag = FALSE;
18464 }

18466
18467 if( i == nLength - 1 || newKeyFlag == TRUE )

18469 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
18470 aDefaultTimeRestrictionSpecification.actions.length(j);
18471

18475 {

18483 }

18485 }

19207// thePre2Script = script, if executionPhase = SP_BRScript_Pre2

19209void PosProcessOperationSpecification_i::setScript( const objectIdentifier& script, const char* executionPhase CORBAENV_LAST_CPP )

19211 SPFW_METHODTRACEENTRY( "PosProcessOperationSpecification::setScript" );

19215 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
19216 CIMFW_SET_DIRTY() ;

19218 PosMESFactory_var aMESFactory;

19220 GET_MANAGER(aMESFactory,PosMESFactory,aCodeManager,getCodeManager);
19221
19222 if( !CIMFWStrCmp(executionPhase, SP_MainDI_PostScript) )
19223 {
19224 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
19225 SET_OBJECTIDENTIFIER_BY_ID_WITH_EXCEPTION(script,thePostScript,aCodeManager,findScriptNamed,PosScript,PosProcessOperationSpecification::SetProcessOperationSpecificationInfoFailedSignal,MSG_OBJECT_NOT_EXIST,"Script");
19226 }

19228 {
19229 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
19230 SET_OBJECTIDENTIFIER_BY_ID_WITH_EXCEPTION(script,thePre1Script,aCodeManager,findScriptNamed,PosScript,PosProcessOperationSpecification::SetProcessOperationSpecificationInfoFailedSignal,MSG_OBJECT_NOT_EXIST,"Script");
19231 }
19232 else if( !CIMFWStrCmp(executionPhase, SP_MainDI_Pre2Script) )
19233 {
19234 SPFW_TRACE_VERBOSE() ;
19235 SET_OBJECTIDENTIFIER_BY_ID_WITH_EXCEPTION(script,thePre2Script,aCodeManager,findScriptNamed,PosScript,PosProcessOperationSpecification::SetProcessOperationSpecificationInfoFailedSignal,MSG_OBJECT_NOT_EXIST,"Script");
19236 }
19237 }

19241 throw ;
19242 }
19243 SPFW_CATCH_FRAMEWORK_AND_SYSTEM_EXCEPTIONS_AND_PROPAGATE_CATCH() ;
19244 SPFW_METHODTRACEEXIT( "PosProcessOperationSpecification::setScript" );
19245}
